safety.connection: Every request uses the enrolled sentry Bearer connection at the compatibility-pinned https://us.sentry.io origin.
safety.credentials: All official operations whose request or response carries DSNs, key secrets, client secrets, signing secrets, symbol-source credentials, webhook headers, or project security tokens are excluded.
safety.requests: Every newly admitted application/json request uses a bounded complete body_raw document. Compatibility operations retain their prior explicit argument surface.
safety.responses: Every admitted JSON response opts into lossless unsafe-integer parsing.
safety.pagination: Only GET operations with a documented cursor and a mergeable array response claim RFC5988 Link-header pagination.
safety.cache: New reads are uncached. Compatibility reads retain their prior cache and approval contracts.
safety.regional_hosts: The official schema declares a regional server variable. The root preserves the prior us.sentry.io connection contract; host selection is not exposed as an operation argument.
